about: Sky films: a station's scene with each frame's stars from a frame-by-frame bake, rendered by render/build.py --sky-film ID, frames in build/films/ID/frames, encoded to `out`. The camera eases from `from` to `to`, the arriving leaf's own view, so the last frame hands over to its panorama. Composition (the views, the length) is a look choice; every star's place is the bake's.

films.name: Leo winds back over the First Time lion, from today's sky to 10,500 BCE, at the spring equinox's nautical twilight
